umbrella_agency.quote: All services concerning this chapter, including, but not limited to, recordkeeping services, examination services, legal services, and investigative services, and those services in chapter 455 necessary to perform the duties of this chapter shall be provided by the Division of Real Estate.

An active real estate sales associate's license for at least 24 months during the preceding 5 years in the office of one or more real estate brokers licensed in this state or any other state

duration.quote: An active real estate sales associate's license for at least 24 months during the preceding 5 years

kind.quote: An active real estate sales associate's license for at least 24 months during the preceding 5 years in the office of one or more real estate brokers licensed in this state or any other state

exams.name: Florida Real Estate Broker Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must pass the state examination. Course completion (72 classroom hours) is a prerequisite. Application expires 2 years after receipt if exam not passed; course completion invalid after 2 years.
exams.quote: The commission shall certify for licensure any applicant who satisfies the requirements of ss. 475.17, 475.175, and 475.180.

interval_years.quote: satisfactorily completed at least 14 classroom hours of 50 minutes each of a continuing education course during each biennium of a license period

required.quote: The renewal application for an active license as broker, broker associate, or sales associate shall include proof satisfactory to the commission that the licensee has, since the issuance or renewal of her or his current license, satisfactorily completed at least 14 classroom hours of 50 minutes each of a continuing education course during each biennium of a license period

hours_per_period.quote: satisfactorily completed at least 14 classroom hours of 50 minutes each of a continuing education course during each biennium of a license period

period_years.quote: at least 14 classroom hours of 50 minutes each of a continuing education course during each biennium of a license period

available.quote: the commission in its discretion may enter into written agreements with similar licensing authorities of other states, territories, or jurisdictions of the United States or foreign national jurisdictions to ensure for Florida licensees nonresident licensure opportunities comparable to those afforded to nonresidents by this section

requirements.value: Commission may enter written agreements with other jurisdictions. Nonresidents from jurisdictions without comparable reciprocity may be required to meet education, experience, and examination requirements not exceeding those of Florida.
requirements.quote: Whenever the commission determines that another jurisdiction does not offer nonresident licensure to Florida licensees substantially comparable to those afforded to licensees of that jurisdiction by this section, the commission shall require licensees of that jurisdiction who apply for nonresident licensure to meet education, experience, and examination requirements substantially comparable to those required by that jurisdiction

exists.quote: There is created within the department the Florida Real Estate Commission. The commission shall consist of seven members who shall be appointed by the Governor

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not operate as a broker or sales associate without being the holder of a valid and current active license therefor. Any person who violates this paragraph commits a felony of the third degree

credential_type.quote: The department shall license any applicant whom the commission certifies, pursuant to subsection (2), to be qualified to practice as a broker or sales associate.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not operate as a broker or sales associate without being the holder of a valid and current active license therefor.

title_protection.quote: A person may not operate as a broker under a trade name without causing the trade name to be noted in the records of the commission and placed on the person's license

scope_protection.quote: A person may not operate as a broker or sales associate without being the holder of a valid and current active license therefor. Any person who violates this paragraph commits a felony of the third degree

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any provision of s. 455.227(1) or s. 475.42.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of s. 455.227(1) or s. 475.42.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, false promises, culpable negligence, or breach of trust in any business transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been guilty of fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, false promises, false pretenses, dishonest dealing by trick, scheme, or device, culpable negligence, or breach of trust in any business transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has advertised property or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has advertised property or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to account for or deliver money, funds, or other property entrusted to the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to account or deliver to any person, including a licensee under this chapter, at the time which has been agreed upon or is required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any provision of this chapter or any lawful order or rule made or issued under this chapter or chapter 455.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any of the provisions of this chapter or any lawful order or rule made or issued under the provisions of this chapter or chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been convicted of or pled nolo contendere to a crime relating to activities of a licensed broker or sales associate, or involving moral turpitude or fraudulent/dishonest dealing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted or found guilty of, or entered a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the activities of a licensed broker or sales associate, or involves moral turpitude or fraudulent or dishonest dealing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has had a broker's or sales associate's license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a broker's or sales associate's license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, or has had an application for such licensure denied, by the real estate licensing agency of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has shared a commission or paid compensation to a person not properly licensed as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has shared a commission with, or paid a fee or other compensation to, a person not properly licensed as a broker, broker associate, or sales associate under the laws of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has become temporarily incapacitated from acting as a broker or sales associate due to drunkenness, drug use, or temporary mental derangement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has become temporarily incapacitated from acting as a broker or sales associate with safety to investors or those in a fiduciary relation with her or him because of drunkenness, use of drugs, or temporary mental derangement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has rendered an opinion that title to any property sold is good without proper legal basis.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has rendered an opinion that the title to any property sold is good or merchantable, except when correctly based upon a current opinion of a licensed attorney at law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to immediately place funds entrusted to broker in escrow as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed, if a broker, to immediately place, upon receipt, any money, fund, deposit, check, or draft entrusted to her or him by any person dealing with her or him as a broker in escrow

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has made or filed a false report or record, or willfully failed to file a required report or record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made or filed a report or record which the licensee knows to be false, has willfully failed to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has obtained a license by means of fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained a license by means of fraud, misrepresentation, or concealment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is confined in a jail, prison, or mental institution, or can no longer safely be entrusted to deal with the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is confined in any county jail, postadjudication; is confined in any state or federal prison or mental institution; is under home confinement ordered in lieu of institutional confinement; or, through mental disease or deterioration, can no longer safely be entrusted to competently deal with the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been found guilty a second time of misconduct warranting suspension, or has shown a course of incompetent, negligent, dishonest, or untruthful conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty, for a second time, of any misconduct that warrants her or his suspension or has been found guilty of a course of conduct or practices which show that she or he is so incompetent, negligent, dishonest, or untruthful

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to inform the commission in writing within 30 days after pleading guilty or being convicted of any felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to inform the commission in writing within 30 days after pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted or found guilty of, any felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any provision of s. 475.2755 or s. 475.278, including duties owed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of s. 475.2755 or s. 475.278, including the duties owed under those sections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to include required elements in a written listing agreement or failed to provide a copy to the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed in any written listing agreement to include a definite expiration date, description of the property, price and terms, fee or commission, and a proper signature of the principal(s)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has had a registration suspended, revoked, or otherwise acted against in any jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a registration suspended, revoked, or otherwise acted against in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has violated any standard of professional appraisal practice adopted by the Florida Real Estate Appraisal Board (does not apply to comparative market analysis or broker price opinion in ordinary course of business).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any standard of professional practice adopted by rule of the Florida Real Estate Appraisal Board, including standards for the development or communication of a real estate appraisal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed, if a broker, to direct, control, or manage a broker associate or sales associate employed by such broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed, if a broker, to direct, control, or manage a broker associate or sales associate employed by such broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed, if a broker, to review the brokerage's trust accounting procedures to ensure compliance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed, if a broker, to review the brokerage's trust accounting procedures in order to ensure compliance with this chapter.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each active broker shall maintain an office, which shall consist of at least one enclosed room in a building of stationary construction.

definition_quote.value: "Broker" means a person who, for another, and for a compensation or valuable consideration directly or indirectly paid or promised, expressly or impliedly, or with an intent to collect or receive a compensation or valuable consideration therefor, appraises, auctions, sells, exchanges, buys, rents, or offers, attempts or agrees to appraise, auction, or negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, or rental of business enterprises or business opportunities or any real property or any interest in or concerning the same
definition_quote.quote: "Broker" means a person who, for another, and for a compensation or valuable consideration directly or indirectly paid or promised, expressly or impliedly, or with an intent to collect or receive a compensation or valuable consideration therefor, appraises, auctions, sells, exchanges, buys, rents, or offers, attempts or agrees to appraise, auction, or negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, or rental of business enterprises or business opportunities or any real property or any interest in or concerning the same

value: advertise rental property information or lists
methods_authorized.quote: appraises, auctions, sells, exchanges, buys, rents, or offers, attempts or agrees to appraise, auction, or negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, or rental of business enterprises or business opportunities or any real property

license_tiers.quote: An applicant for licensure who is a natural person must be at least 18 years of age... An applicant for an active broker's license or a sales associate's license

broker_of_record_required.quote: Each partnership, limited liability partnership, limited liability company, or corporation which acts as a broker shall register with the commission... If the license or registration of at least one active broker member is not in force, the registration of a corporation, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, or partnership is canceled automatically

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: An active real estate sales associate's license for at least 24 months during the preceding 5 years in the office of one or more real estate brokers licensed in this state or any other state

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: The course or courses required for one to become initially licensed shall not exceed a total of 63 classroom hours of 50 minutes each, inclusive of examination, for a sales associate and 72 classroom hours of 50 minutes each, inclusive of examination, for a broker.

required_instruction_topics.quote: one or more subjects which include, but are not limited to, advanced appraisal, advanced property management, real estate marketing, business law, advanced real estate investment analyses, advanced legal aspects, general accounting, real estate economics, syndications, commercial brokerage, feasibility analyses, advanced real estate finance, residential brokerage, advanced marketing, technology, advanced business planning, time management, or real estate brokerage office operations

exam_application_window_years.quote: The application shall expire 2 years after the date received if the applicant does not pass the appropriate examination. Additionally, if an applicant does not pass the licensing examination within 2 years after the successful course completion date, the applicant's successful course completion is invalid for licensure.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: Any license that has been involuntarily inactive for more than 2 years shall automatically expire.

agency_relationship_types.quote: A real estate licensee in this state may enter into a brokerage relationship as either a transaction broker or as a single agent with potential buyers and sellers. A real estate licensee may not operate as a disclosed or nondisclosed dual agent.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A real estate licensee may not operate as a disclosed or nondisclosed dual agent.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: in any real estate transaction other than a residential sale as defined in s. 475.278(5)(a), and where the buyer and seller have assets of $1 million or more, the broker at the request of the customers may designate sales associates to act as single agents for different customers in the same transaction.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: A transaction broker provides a limited form of representation to a buyer, a seller, or both in a real estate transaction but does not represent either in a fiduciary capacity or as a single agent.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: Duties of a single agent must be fully described and disclosed in writing to a buyer or seller either as a separate and distinct disclosure document or included as part of another document such as a listing agreement or other agreement for representation. The disclosure must be made before, or at the time of, entering into a listing agreement or an agreement for representation or before the showing of property, whichever occurs first.

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Has failed in any written listing agreement to include a definite expiration date, description of the property, price and terms, fee or commission, and a proper signature of the principal(s)

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Each broker shall preserve at least one legible copy of all books, accounts, and records pertaining to her or his real estate brokerage business for at least 5 years from the date of receipt of any money, fund, deposit, check, or draft entrusted to the broker

escrow_account_required.quote: Has failed, if a broker, to immediately place, upon receipt, any money, fund, deposit, check, or draft entrusted to her or him by any person dealing with her or him as a broker in escrow with a title company, banking institution, credit union, or savings and loan association located and doing business in this state, or to deposit such funds in a trust or escrow account maintained by her or him

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A broker may place and maintain up to $5,000 of personal or brokerage funds in the broker's property management escrow account and up to $1,000 of personal or brokerage funds in the broker's sales escrow account.

fixed_office_required.quote: Each active broker shall maintain an office, which shall consist of at least one enclosed room in a building of stationary construction.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A person licensed as a sales associate may not operate as a broker or operate as a sales associate for any person not registered as her or his employer.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: There is created the Florida Real Estate Recovery Fund as a separate account in the Professional Regulation Trust Fund.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: in an amount equal to the unsatisfied portion of such person's judgment or $50,000, whichever is less

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: Payments for claims based upon judgments against any one broker or sales associate may not exceed, in the aggregate, $150,000.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: This paragraph does not apply to a real estate broker or sales associate who, in the ordinary course of business, performs a comparative market analysis, gives a broker price opinion, or gives an opinion of value of real estate. However, in no event may this comparative market analysis, broker price opinion, or opinion of value of real estate be referred to as an appraisal

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: This paragraph does not apply to a real estate broker or sales associate who, in the ordinary course of business, performs a comparative market analysis, gives a broker price opinion, or gives an opinion of value of real estate.

license_exemptions.quote: This part does not apply to: (1) Any person acting as an attorney in fact for the purpose of the execution of contracts or conveyances only
